module.purpose: Implements GROUP BY query compilation for a database query system, transforming data streams into grouped aggregations with support for aggregate functions, HAVING clauses, and SELECT expressions.
module.summary: This file provides the core GROUP BY processing logic for a database query compiler. It handles both single-group (empty GROUP BY) and multi-group aggregations, manages aggregate function compilation (sum, count, avg, min, max), validates that non-aggregate SELECT expressions appear in GROUP BY, processes HAVING clauses, and maintains virtual row metadata for sync status and local origin tracking.
module.businessContext: Enables SQL-like GROUP BY operations in a reactive database query system. Critical for data aggregation features; failures cause incorrect aggregated results and query failures.
